newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs seen rising on improving fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs seen rising on improving fundamentals.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to rise on Monday as improving fundamentals keep investor sentiment buoyant, brokers said.
The composite stock index closed 10.41 points higher at 756.77 on Saturday.
"A batch of indicators released last month showed an economic recovery was imminent," said Lim Bok-kyu, a broker at Hyundai Securities.
Brokers said low interest rates and a high yen would help improve South Korean industrial competitiveness.
On Friday, the National Statistical Office (NSO) said the nation's industrial production rose 10.7 percent year-on-year in April, up from an 8.4 percent rise a year earlier.
The Ministry of Finance and Economy also reported 3.8 percent year-on-year inflation in May, compared to 5.1 percent a year earlier.
Economists said those figures raised hopes of an imminent economic recovery.
Yields on three-year corporates, South Korea's benchmark interest rates closed flat at 11.86 percent on Friday.
